# Forum debate: Darth Vader vs Revan (Suspect Insight)

**URL:** https://www.suspectinsightforums.com/t1140-darth-vader-versus-revan (`/t1140p25-`, `p50`)
**Pages read:** 3 of 3 (about 69 posts). Raw: `forum-raw/t1140_pg1..3.html`, `t1140.s.txt`.

## Conditions
ANH Vader vs novel Revan (recovered). Fought in a krayt dragon cave. Rounds: sabers, Force, all-out. Bonus: Scourge + Meetra.

## Arguments for REVAN
- **KingofBlades, two chains** (see below). He also cites the ESB draft where Ben rates Vader "4", to argue that ANH-era Vader is low.
- **AncientPower:** Meetra was hindered by the nexus in the Revan novel, which matters for the bonus round.
- Revan in all rounds: Guest, DC77, MP, MasterCilghal.

## Arguments for VADER
- **The Ellimist:** Jax Pavon, Ferus Olin, Kar Vastor, Kota ragdolled, and TFU2 showings.
- **BreakofDawn:** Vader wins sabers.
- ArkhamAsylum3/NotAA3 and BreakofDawn argue over whether the TFU/TFU2 Starkiller wins against Vader are discounted by Starkiller's exhaustion.
- DarthAnt66 promised a "Revan-sabers" counter-case, which never appeared.

## Counterarguments and rebuttals
- The ESB draft "4" → the Vader side argues drafts are not canon. Unresolved in the thread.
- The Starkiller-exhaustion argument went back and forth (AA3 vs BreakofDawn). Nobody conceded.

## Verdict tally (POSTER OPINION)
| Round | Vader | Revan |
|---|---|---|
| Sabers | 3 (SithSauce, BreakofDawn, dark_globe) | 4+ (Guest, DC77, MP, MasterCilghal) |
| Force | 0 | 7 (all of the above) |
| All-out | 0 | 7 |
Overall: **Revan takes Force and all-out. Sabers are split.**

## Scaling chains used
- KingofBlades: "Revan Reborn>>>>>Nyriss>>Meetra Surik>Traya>>Kreia>>>>Three Jedi Masters"
- KingofBlades: "Revan Reborn>KotOR Revan>>SF Malak>Peak Exar Kun>>>lifting a derriphan class battle cruiser~guiding a falling ISD"
- The Ellimist: Vader > Jax / Ferus / Kar Vastor / Kota.

## Conflicts with our notes
- **Supported:** Revan Reborn > Nyriss (`revan-legends-quotes.txt`, the Nyriss ash feat).
- **Conflict:** "Revan Reborn >>>>> Nyriss" and "Nyriss >> Meetra" put Nyriss above Meetra, but nothing in our notes compares Meetra and Nyriss. Unsupported.
- **Not in our notes:** the ESB draft "4" quote, and the derriphan battle-cruiser / falling-ISD comparison.

## Original-work check (added 2026-10-11)
Each quote, scan or feat cited above, with its original work. "Named in thread" means a poster gave the work. "From our notes" means the same quote is in one of our files, with the source shown there. "NOT IDENTIFIED" means neither the thread nor our notes give the work. Those are left unsourced, not guessed. Poster verdicts and opinions are not listed.
- ESB draft where Ben rates Vader "4" → posters describe it as an ESB story-conference/draft session (`forum-raw/t1140.txt` L177, L273). The exact document/page is NOT IDENTIFIED.
- Vader vs Jax Pavon → the *Coruscant Nights* novels. Vader vs Ferus Olin → *The Last of the Jedi* series. Kota ragdolled → *The Force Unleashed*. Scenes not given. Kar Vastor → NOT IDENTIFIED.
- Revan Reborn > Nyriss → *The Old Republic: Revan* (`revan-legends-quotes.txt`, Wookieepedia ref 9).
- Meetra hindered by the nexus → *The Old Republic: Revan*, per AncientPower. Chapter NOT IDENTIFIED.
- Exar Kun lifting a derriphan-class battleship; guiding a falling ISD → no works named (`forum-raw/t1140.txt` L259, L381). NOT IDENTIFIED. (Nihilus and the Ravager, which the poster compares, is *KOTOR II*.)
